name: Deep sea glow
one_line: Black-blue water lit only by living things.
look_words: The deep ocean, where the only light is alive. Water is black-blue; rock walls are barely there, a shade lighter than the dark. Sea plants, jellyfish and small creatures glow in teal and soft violet, and those glows are small, soft and separate, never a haze. The player carries the one warm light, a yellow lamp with a short beam. Red-pink glow means harm. Shapes are simple and rounded; far things are silhouettes. Motion is slow and floating: drifting specks, pulsing jellyfish, plants swaying in a current. Avoid bright ambient light, surface sunbeams everywhere, bloom that smears the glows together, and clutter.

palette.name: deep sea
palette.notes: Everything bright is an accent or the player, so keep them rare. Thick fog stands in for dark water. Light comes weakly from above.

look_wish: soft drawn glows with no bloom haze, or none

upgrade.why: glowing creatures that drift, blink and react to the player without blown-out bloom
a sonar ping that draws the dark world as glowing points

music.mood: slow, deep drones and soft bells

sound_feel: muffled, deep; sonar pings, bubbles, low hums
